bottleneck: In 'battery-return' the agent committed to a parcel route whose round-trip cost exceeded its energy, so 3 return actions were blocked by exhaustion even though a recharge battery sat directly on the path.
rationale: Add a resource-aware task utility: compute the intended parcel's round-trip cost (2*distance + pickup + putdown). When that cost exceeds current energy and a battery is co-located, the recharge pickup is a net-positive moment, so select it now instead of committing to the parcel route; this refuels before spending energy on delivery. Defers (undefined) whenever energy is untracked, a parcel is already carried, no parcel is open, the route is already affordable, or no battery is co-located, protecting holdout behavior.
expectedMetric: battery-return: achieved true, score 10 (was 0), energy-blocked actions 0 (was 3); no regressions on key-door-delivery, simple-delivery, two-parcels, detour-delivery.
source: (context) => { const o = context.observation; if (!o || !o.me) return undefined; if (typeof o.energy !== 'number') return undefined; const parcels = o.parcels || []; if (parcels.some((p) => p.carriedBy)) return undefined; const open = parcels.filter((p) => !p.carriedBy); if (open.length === 0) return undefined; const dist = (a, b) => Math.abs(a.x - b.x) + Math.abs(a.y - b.y); const best = open.reduce((a, b) => ((b.reward || 0) > (a.reward || 0) ? b : a)); const d = dist(o.me, best); const roundTrip = 2 * d + 2; if (o.energy >= roundTrip) return undefined; const batteries = o.batteries || []; if (!batteries.some((b) => dist(o.me, b) === 0)) return undefined; return { action: { kind: 'pickup' }, confidence: 0.85, rationale: 'Best parcel round-trip cost ' + roundTrip + ' exceeds energy ' + o.energy + '; a co-located battery is a net-positive recharge, so pick it up before committing to the parcel route.' }; }
